about.text: A full-fat, semi-hard alp cheese from the canton of Glarus, about 5 to 9 kg, with no holes. It is made from raw milk of cows grazing alpine pastures in the alp season, set with calf rennet and smeared during ripening; it has been a protected AOP since 2014.

sources.text: Its making, ripening and output, from the first; its AOP status, size and holes, from the second.
